withdrawalSettings.subtitle: Global withdrawal policy, base fee configuration, and per-coin fee & limits
withdrawalSettings.maxPendingDesc: Maximum number of pending (unprocessed) withdrawal requests allowed per user at any time.

withdrawalSettings.feeFormulaNote: Base fee covers on-chain gas costs. Platform fee (%) is your revenue margin. Both are configured per coin-network in the Fee & Limits tab.

gasSettings.title: Gas Settings
gasSettings.subtitle: Configure gas price multipliers, gas limit buffers, and topup amounts per network
gasSettings.gasPriceInfo: Gas price multipliers control how aggressively transactions are priced. Higher multipliers = faster confirmation but higher cost. BSC uses Legacy (gasPrice only), all other networks use EIP-1559 (base + priority fee).
gasSettings.gasLimitInfo: Gas limit multiplier is applied after estimateGas() to add a safety buffer, preventing out-of-gas failures. Unused gas is NOT charged.
gasSettings.gasTopupInfo: Max topup amount is the safety cap for native coin sent to temp wallets for gas. The actual topup is calculated based on gas deficit.
gasSettings.maxGasPriceDesc: Safety cap — transactions will not exceed this gas price regardless of multipliers.
gasSettings.gasLimitMultiplierDesc: Applied to estimateGas() result. 1.10 = 10% buffer, 1.20 = 20% buffer.
gasSettings.maxTopupAmountDesc: Maximum native coin to send per topup operation. Safety cap to prevent over-funding temp wallets.
gasSettings.gasLimitFormulaNote: Example: estimateGas() = 21,000 × 1.15 = 24,150 gas limit. Unused gas is not charged.
gasSettings.gasTopupHowItWorksDesc: When a temp wallet needs to sweep tokens but lacks gas, the system sends native coin from the gas wallet. The topup amount = (required gas) − (current balance), capped at the max topup amount above.

rbfSettings.title: RBF Settings
rbfSettings.subtitle: Configure Replace-by-Fee behavior for stuck transactions across all EVM networks
rbfSettings.globalInfo: Global RBF settings apply across all networks. These control dropped transaction detection, system-wide rate limiting, and safety limits.
rbfSettings.droppedDetectionDesc: When a transaction disappears from the mempool for too long, it is considered dropped
rbfSettings.minNotFoundCountDesc: Number of consecutive checks where transaction is not found before considering it dropped.
rbfSettings.minNotFoundDurationDesc: Minimum time (milliseconds) a transaction must be missing before considering it dropped.
rbfSettings.rateLimitingDesc: Prevents excessive RBF replacements that could waste gas fees
rbfSettings.maxRbfPerHourDesc: Maximum number of RBF replacement transactions the system can submit per hour (global).
rbfSettings.maxRbfPerAddressDesc: Maximum number of RBF replacement transactions per wallet address.
rbfSettings.safetyDesc: Hard limits to prevent runaway replacement loops
rbfSettings.maxReplacementsPerTxDesc: Maximum number of times a single transaction can be replaced. Prevents infinite replacement loops.
rbfSettings.networkInfo: Per-network RBF settings control gas bump percentages, timing thresholds, and cost limits. Each network has different optimal values based on block times and gas price volatility.
rbfSettings.howRbfWorksDesc: When a transaction is stuck pending longer than Min Pending duration, the system bumps the gas price by the Gas Bump percentage and resubmits. Replacements are spaced by the Replace Interval. Cost guards (Min Amount, Max Cost Ratio, Max Cost USD) prevent uneconomical replacements.
rbfSettings.enabledDesc: Enable or disable RBF for this network.
rbfSettings.gasBumpPercentDesc: Percentage to increase gas price when submitting RBF replacement.
rbfSettings.minAmountUsdDesc: Minimum transaction USD value to allow RBF.
rbfSettings.maxCostRatioDesc: Max gas cost as fraction of tx value (0.05 = 5%).
rbfSettings.maxCostUsdDesc: Maximum USD gas cost for a single RBF replacement.
